scientific limitations/integrity: The result is restricted to closed connected embedded minimal hypersurfaces with spatially constant S and f3 in dimensions n>=5. It combines the proved local finiteness of their S-value set with the proved sharp second gap and Cartan endpoint classification. The resulting delta_n is existential and dimension-dependent; no explicit numerical lower bound, next curvature value, or immersed analogue is claimed.
title: Local finiteness forces a uniform post-Cartan curvature gap
